purpose: Realistic Renaissance sepia engineering studies behind the playable SVG apparatus
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a transparent game-background illustration, landscape 3:2, for an inventor's marble-routing puzzle.
Primary request: convincing Leonardo da Vinci-style Renaissance engineering notebook pen studies. Draw actual three-dimensional mechanisms with fine sepia iron-gall ink, delicate uneven quill strokes, dense accurate contour cross-hatching, natural hand-drawn construction marks and authentic observed proportions. A precisely rendered bevel gear and axle assembly in perspective with visible wooden hub, dovetailed supports, teeth, and a small cutaway in the upper left; an anatomically convincing articulated bat/bird wing study in the upper right with individual bones, tendons, membrane folds and feather groups; a modest screw-and-pulley experiment with rope, hanging weight and wooden frame in the lower left; a small escapement detail along the far right. These are original illustrations inspired by Renaissance notebooks, not copies of a particular page.
Composition: sparse marginal studies on an otherwise empty transparent sheet. Keep the central vertical corridor (roughly 38% to 62% of the width) almost entirely empty for the playable machine. Keep the top 10% and bottom 15% empty for controls and bins. Gear study centered around 16% across, 34% down, occupying about 24% of the width. Wing study centered at 80% across, 24% down, about 28% wide. Screw/pulley at 15% across, 65% down, about 20% wide. Escapement at 90% across, 61% down, about 12% wide. Studies do not touch each other or the edges.
Palette: only warm walnut-brown/sepia ink; details have crisp fine lines and softly hatched shaded volumes. No solid black patches. No paper or colored background: true alpha transparency everywhere between the ink marks, no white rectangles or outer shadow.
Text: no lettering, no labels, no numbers, no signature, no watermark; the game adds its own real notes.
Avoid: flat diagram icons, clean vector outlines, cartoons, gold 3D rendered game pieces, photoreal objects without hand-drawn strokes, big central illustration, fake readable text, opaque parchment.
